summary: Invoice line for decommissioned private deployment appears on final bill (suspected late postback)
description:
Issue summary: Customer BrightHealth AI reports a line item on their finalized invoice for tokens consumed by a private deployment that was decommissioned prior to the billing window. Impact: Customer received a $4,120 invoice line referencing 'private-deploy-nyc-04 / kv-cache-warmup' for 2026-03-09 which should not have occurred. This is blocking autopay for the account and impacting finance reconciliation.

Environment: Private deployment (customer-managed VPC) deployed in us-east region; deployment id: pd-nyc-04; decommissioned via Console UI on 2026-03-08T22:00:12Z (audit: audit.log#pd-nyc-04-decom). Bill line/invoice: INV-2026-03-09-8891, line description: "kv-cache-warmup - private-deploy-nyc-04" amount: $4,120.

Steps to reproduce (customer flow):
1) Customer decommissions private deployment through Console -> Private Deployments -> pd-nyc-04 on 2026-03-08T22:00:12Z.
2) Customer verifies capacity removed, no active endpoints in Console.
3) Finalized invoice dated 2026-03-09 contains unexpected line referencing the decommissioned deployment.

Observed logs (support traces):
- reconciler logs show acceptance of a postback: pbk-7f4e2c on 2026-03-09T00:10:42+02:00 (server-local) with payload indicating 1.2M tokens warmup.
- postback metadata: origin_host=private-deploy-nyc-04, local_timestamp=2026-03-08T22:08:19Z, reported_tokens=1,200,456, queued=true.
- audit trail: Console decommission event exists and shows deployment state=DECOMMISSIONED at 2026-03-08T22:00:12Z.

Initial hypothesis: A worker in the customer's private deployment queued a postback after decommissioning (either due to delayed shutdown or clock skew). The reconciler accepted the postback because it lacked a guard for postbacks whose origin deployment is already marked DECOMMISSIONED and which arrive after the billing window cutoff. Another possibility is a replay from a cached forwarder in the private network.

Requested from customer: Any local logs showing agent shutdown timeline (pid lifecycles), and confirmation whether there were planned network interruptions or firewall NAT churn between 2026-03-08T21:50Z and 2026-03-09T01:00Z.

Desired outcome: Remove the charge from the finalized invoice (credit), apply protective guard in reconciler to reject late postbacks from decommissioned private deployments, and add monitoring alert for postbacks referencing decommissioned deployment ids.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Aisha Khan (Support): Acknowledged receipt from customer. Opened internal investigation with billing and SRE. Created linked internal ticket INT-3312 to triage reconciler logic for decommissioned deployments.

2026-03-10 - Customer (BrightHealth AI - Jordan Lee): Provided agent logs and agent shutdown stdout/stderr (attached). Logs show agent process stopped at 2026-03-08T22:05:30Z but the local forwarder retried a queued postback at 2026-03-09T00:09:55Z. Quote: 'We did a graceful shutdown; however our NAT gateway rotated at ~23:55.'

2026-03-11 - Tom Becker (Billing Eng): Found invoice line INV-2026-03-09-8891 referencing postback id pbk-7f4e2c. Temporarily applied a provisional credit of $4,120 pending root cause. Documented credit id CR-2026-03-11-719. Noted we should revert if we find valid usage.

2026-03-12 - Priya Malhotra (SRE): Investigated reconciler logs. Found reconciler accepted pbk-7f4e2c at 2026-03-09T00:10:42+02:00 and matched it to deployment pd-nyc-04. Reconciler currently checks deployment existence via the control-plane cache but not the 'decommissioned' flag with an ingress-time window. Hypothesis: control-plane cache TTL allowed stale mapping for 240s during which the late postback was interpreted as from an active deployment.

2026-03-12 - Customer (Jordan Lee): Thanks for provisional credit. We can provide NAT gateway logs if helpful. We confirm we decommissioned pd-nyc-04 on 2026-03-08 at 22:00 UTC and saw a connection retry in their gateway at 00:09 UTC.

2026-03-13 - Tom Becker (Billing Eng): Confirmed credit CR-2026-03-11-719 applied and invoice updated. Will not finalize collection while investigation open. Billing will await SRE remediation timeline before marking as permanent credit.

2026-03-13 - Priya Malhotra (SRE): Raised reconciler PR to add two safeguards: (1) reject postbacks referencing deployments with state=DECOMMISSIONED older than 30s, (2) add dedupe id window for private deployment postbacks of 48 hours. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/reconciler/pull/482. Added monitoring alert 'postback.decommissioned.received' to Sentry and metrics. Requesting security review for dedupe window.

2026-03-13 - Aisha Khan (Support): Notified customer of provisional credit and pending reconciler fix. Asked customer to provide NAT logs; customer replied they will upload by 2026-03-15 if needed. Marking ticket In Progress until reconciler PR is merged and credit finalized.
investigation_notes: Control-plane cache TTL observed at 240s (reconciler node rcv-11). Potential race where reconciler saw mapping for pd-nyc-04 after decommission event due to asynchronous cache invalidation.

Postback arrival times show local_timestamp earlier than reconciler timestamp -> indicates clock skew on origin. Origin local_timestamp=2026-03-08T22:08:19Z, reconciler record 2026-03-09T00:10:42+02:00. Suspect agent reported local wallclock in UTC while reconciler stored local in server-local TZ; verify parsing.

Customer-provided agent logs indicate graceful shutdown but forwarder retried queued messages. NAT gateway rotation likely caused TCP connection resets leading to retry later. Forwarder retry policy currently allows 3 attempts over 4 hours for private deployments.

Billing shows the postback was accepted and consumed by the hourly metering pipeline which had already closed for the 2026-03-08 window. There is no automatic rejection path for postbacks tied to decommissioned deployments at reconciliation time.

Temporary mitigation: provisional credit applied to prevent collection. Long-term: reconciler change + add audit detector to find similar anomalies from last 90 days and auto-flag invoices for manual review.
resolution: Provisional credit CR-2026-03-11-719 applied to customer account for $4,120; invoice INV-2026-03-09-8891 updated and collection paused. Reconciler PR github.com/redwood-inference/reconciler/pull/482 created to: reject postbacks referencing deployments in DECOMMISSIONED state older than 30s, add 48h dedupe window for private deployment postbacks, and emit alert postback.decommissioned.received. SRE estimates merge and rollout to prod by 2026-03-18. Once PR is deployed and confirmed, billing will convert provisional credit to permanent refund and close the ticket. Follow-up: run audit script to surface any similar late postbacks in last 90 days (INT-3312). Pending customer upload of NAT logs for postmortem.
